This ticket should be labeled UNRESOLVED.

The customer's concern was the duplicate charge, and that concern only goes away once the pending authorization actually drops off. I explained why it should, but nobody has confirmed it happened. The customer's last message, "ok, I'll check again on Friday," shows they're still waiting to verify, not that the problem is gone. They haven't said the charge cleared or that they're satisfied.

Labeling it RESOLVED would count it as a success in the quarterly report when the outcome is unknown. If the authorization doesn't drop within the 3-5 business days, the customer will have a real billing problem and the ticket will already be closed. So I agree with Priya's read.

Because the ticket auto-closes tonight, the customer may need a way to reach us again if Friday comes and the charge is still there. If a closing note is possible before tonight, it should tell them to reply or open a new ticket and reference this one if the duplicate charge hasn't cleared by the end of the 3-5 business day window.

LABEL: UNRESOLVED
